title: Wire CarrierOS normalization through RavenOS Sync, persist session-to-dispatch edges, and separate RavenOS durable semantic state from session provenance
objective: Turn the verified Yori compression contracts into source-level implementation: canonical carrier coordinates must drive dispatch discovery, GameOS check-ins must retain distinct ISO/carrier/session coordinates, MicrowaveOS must receive a session mailbox projection, and RavenOS deterministic semantic state must no longer depend on session timestamps.
scope: wire CarrierOS CARRIER-RESOLVE into RAVENOS-SYNC dispatch discovery
support AUTO carrier recovery from current GameOS session without caller-private vocabulary
persist canonical carrier_id carrier_type proof_lane alongside GameOS session check-in
project current session to the matching MicrowaveOS carrier lane without moving work authority
add Conversations coordinate contract for ISO_ID CARRIER_ID SESSION_ID provenance
repair RavenOS universal controller semantic checksum so timestamp and session id are provenance only
preserve RavenOS motif/semantic continuity when presentation intensity is reduced
seed the currently proven ATOM CHATGPT_CONNECTOR session binding from current main
add source canaries for the failing CHATGPT_CONNECTOR to GPT_ATOM route
forbidden_mutations: identity merge between GPT and OpenHands realizations
runtime proof inflation from connector-source edits
CarrierOS ownership of ISO identity or mission authority
session id or timestamp as RavenOS semantic cause
deletion of existing RavenOS or transaction history
acceptance_criteria: CHATGPT_CONNECTOR + ATOM resolves to GPT_ATOM / GPT_CONNECTOR / CONNECTOR_SOURCE
RAVENOS-SYNC discovery matches canonical carrier coordinates instead of raw string equality
AUTO carrier input can recover from an existing GameOS current pointer
GameOS check-in stores native carrier label and canonical carrier coordinates separately
MicrowaveOS Sessions projection binds ISO + carrier + session to the active dispatch and packet
Conversations contract requires ISO_ID != CARRIER_ID != SESSION_ID
RavenOS universal state key excludes timestamp and session id
RAVENOS OFF lowers presentation only and does not clear semantic motif continuity
current-main source receipt preserves NOT_EXECUTED runtime ceiling
